label: Jev vs conventional LLM selector in shared harness
scope: Local deterministic browser fixtures only; this does not compare autonomous production agents.

arms.selector: TypeSafe Jev 1.13 via OpenRouter decisions API
Inception Mercury 2.5 choosing among the same observed operation/target candidates

shared_harness.executor: Repository Agent and Browser using Browser Harness/CDP
shared_harness.network: Loopback fixture origin only for Chromium; model requests go only to configured OpenRouter endpoints.

families.goal: Enter a synthetic query, select its exact suggestion, submit; oracle checks the submitted query.
Choose a seeded native-select option and apply; oracle checks selected value and result marker.
Scroll to a seeded target link and open it; oracle checks the local destination marker.
Fill a synthetic title, choose a record type, preview; oracle checks exact title and type.
Enable a delayed Continue control, wait as needed, activate it; oracle checks the terminal marker.

sampling.pilot_allocation: One seeded pair per family; pilot is operational validation and excluded from primary inference.
sampling.power_basis: Paired binary non-inferiority approximation: one-sided alpha 0.025 (95% two-sided interval), 90% power, 2 percentage-point margin, 10% discordant pairs; n = ceil((1.96+1.282)^2*0.10/0.02^2) = 2627.
sampling.interpretation_limit: Family-stratified results generalize only to seeded variants of these five fixture families, not to web sites or autonomous agents.

primary_gates.paired_completion_difference: Jev minus Mercury; lower bound of the family-stratified 95% bootstrap CI must be greater than -0.02 for Jev non-inferiority.
primary_gates.inconclusive_if: Main sample is incomplete, the pilot cannot establish bounded cost, provider errors prevent a valid paired sample, or the observed discordance makes the planned power unsupported.

latency: end-to-end p50/p95 from tab creation through independent-oracle completion
agent-loop p50/p95 from first decision through terminal state
cost: cost per completed workflow including selectors, helpers, errors, and any retries

analysis.completion_interval: 20,000-replicate family-stratified paired bootstrap; resample pairs within each fixed family and combine using equal family weights.
analysis.latency_and_cost_intervals: Same paired, family-stratified bootstrap; report medians and p95s plus paired differences and 95% intervals.
analysis.superiority: Claim only if the 95% paired interval shows lower Jev latency or cost (Mercury minus Jev interval lower bound above zero) and the completion non-inferiority and zero-safety gates pass.

metering.reviewer_spend_status: At least $7.931816 is known; two timed-out reviews have unknown cost, so the total and remaining budget are unbounded.
metering.selector_and_helper_calls: Single HTTP attempt per request; no provider retries or fallback. Every request is checked against the remaining budget before sending.
metering.per_call_cost_confirmation: Require the response model and generation record to match the pinned model, response usage counts to match the generation record when present, finite total_cost, and prompt/completion token counts within reserve. Write and fsync an attempt reservation before POST; settle it only after exact generation reconciliation. An interrupted or unreconciled attempt remains reserved at its full bound and blocks resume. A confirmed cost above reserve is charged at its reported amount and stops the run. No inference retries.
metering.durable_spend_ledger: One fsynced append-only ledger at ~/Library/Application Support/jev-ultrafast/paired-selector/spend-ledger.jsonl is shared across this Mac's worktrees and output directories; a process lock prevents concurrent local runs. Pair and ledger records must reconcile before resumption. This file is local to this Mac and does not reconcile other hosts.
metering.missing_usage_policy: Use the full rate-derived request upper bound; if body/output bounds or price cannot be established, stop before the next request.
metering.stop_rule: Stop before any call or pair whose reserved maximum would put cumulative total spend above $24; never exceed the absolute $25 cap.

pilot_stop_conditions: main sample upper-bound projection exceeds the $24 operational stop

test_only_task_failure_continuation.scope: One explicit continuation of the existing authorized local-fixture pilot after its original smoke row is preserved.
test_only_task_failure_continuation.eligible_failures: A blocked or incomplete task with valid bounded provider calls, a preserved loopback origin, and no safety violations; decision/text-helper validation failures remain outcomes.

single_pre_provider_recovery.eligibility: Only the recorded local metering authorization-forwarding failure, after proving request-log and ledger attempt IDs exactly match the original smoke row and no pilot row exists.
